boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of Illinois Chicago
boards.description: Ten named, under-21-safe food stops with officially published late availability in and around UIC’s Near West Side setting.

cards.title: Jim's Original
cards.subtitle: 1250 S Union Ave, Chicago, IL 60607
cards.notes: Use the official location page to confirm the stand before heading out; its published 24/7 availability makes timing unusually flexible.
cards.short_summary: A named Maxwell Street food stand with published around-the-clock service.
cards.evidence_claim: Jim's Original lists its 1250 S Union Ave Chicago location and says it is open 24/7.

cards.title: White Castle on Roosevelt
cards.subtitle: 2356 W Roosevelt Rd, Chicago, IL 60608
cards.notes: Check the location’s ordering options and use the published 24-hour schedule when you need a food-only stop after evening commitments.
cards.short_summary: A Roosevelt Road White Castle with officially listed 24-hour operation.
cards.evidence_claim: White Castle lists the 2356 W Roosevelt Rd location in Chicago and identifies its Castle Hours as open 24 hours.

cards.title: Five Guys Medical District
cards.subtitle: 703 S Seely Ave, Chicago, IL 60612
cards.notes: Plan a dine-in, takeout, or delivery order from the Medical District location; check the day’s posted hours before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: A Medical District burger-and-fries stop with a listed midnight close.
cards.evidence_claim: Five Guys lists its Medical District location at 703 S Seely Ave and shows it closes at 12:00 AM.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists store hours through 12:00 AM and identifies dine-in, takeout, and delivery.

cards.title: Chick-fil-A Illinois Medical District
cards.subtitle: 713 S Seeley Ave, Chicago, IL 60612
cards.notes: For a food-only evening stop, use this Medical District address Monday through Saturday and note the official Sunday closure.
cards.short_summary: A nearby counter-service restaurant with service published to 10 PM Monday through Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Chick-fil-A lists the Illinois Medical District location at 713 S Seeley Ave with carry-out and delivery hours until 10:00 PM Monday through Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists Monday–Saturday service from 6:30 AM to 10:00 PM; closed Sundays.

cards.title: Rosati's Pizza Tri-Taylor
cards.subtitle: 1014 S Western Ave, Chicago, IL 60612
cards.notes: Use the direct ordering page for pickup or delivery, especially on the published late-hour nights; recheck hours if plans shift.
cards.short_summary: A Tri-Taylor pizzeria listing late carryout and delivery hours every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Rosati's Pizza Tri-Taylor lists 1014 S Western Ave and hours until 2 AM Sunday–Thursday and 3 AM Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists 10 AM–2 AM Sunday–Thursday and 10 AM–3 AM Friday–Saturday; carryout and delivery are offered.

cards.title: Jason's Deli on Canal
cards.subtitle: 1258 S Canal St, Chicago, IL 60607
cards.notes: Use this Canal Street location for a weekday evening pickup, curbside, or delivery plan; weekend closing times are earlier on its official page.
cards.short_summary: A Canal Street deli with weekday service listed until 10 PM.
cards.evidence_claim: Jason's Deli lists its 1258 S Canal St Chicago location and Monday–Friday hours from 6 AM to 10 PM.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists pickup, curbside, and delivery, with Monday–Friday hours until 10:00 PM.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Taylor
cards.subtitle: 1429 W Taylor St, Chicago, IL 60607
cards.notes: Use the Taylor Street restaurant’s official store page to check the current late drive-through window and place a food order.
cards.short_summary: A Taylor Street Taco Bell whose official locator identifies late-night availability.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official Chicago locator identifies a restaurant at 1429 W Taylor St and lists it as open until 3:00 AM.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 57 N Western Ave location page
cards.access_notes: The official locator’s nearby-restaurants listing identifies 1429 W Taylor St as open until 3:00 AM; confirm exact service mode before travel.

cards.title: Taco Bell on North Western
cards.subtitle: 57 N Western Ave, Chicago, IL 60612
cards.notes: Choose drive-through, takeout, or delivery as appropriate; the official schedule distinguishes late drive-through access from earlier dine-in hours.
cards.short_summary: A West Side Taco Bell with officially listed drive-through hours into the early morning.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists the 57 N Western Ave Chicago location with drive-through hours until 3 AM on some weekdays and 4 AM Thursday through Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists drive-through through 3 AM Tuesday–Wednesday and 4 AM Thursday–Saturday; dine-in is listed to 10 PM.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Roosevelt
cards.subtitle: 3350 W Roosevelt Rd, Chicago, IL 60624
cards.notes: If using this farther Roosevelt Road location, verify travel and choose the posted drive-through option for the late-hour window.
cards.short_summary: A Roosevelt Road Taco Bell with early-morning drive-through hours listed by the brand.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists the 3350 W Roosevelt Rd location with drive-through hours until 2 AM daily and 3 AM Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists drive-through through 2 AM Sunday–Thursday and 3 AM Friday–Saturday; dine-in hours end earlier.

cards.title: Taco Bell on South Western
cards.subtitle: 2410 S Western Ave, Chicago, IL 60608
cards.notes: Use the official locator and confirm service availability at this South Western Avenue stop before making a late food run.
cards.short_summary: A South Western Avenue Taco Bell identified by the official locator as 24-hour.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official Chicago locator identifies the 2410 S Western Ave restaurant as open 24 hours.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 3350 W Roosevelt Rd location page
cards.access_notes: The official locator’s nearby-restaurants listing identifies 2410 S Western Ave as “Open 24 Hours”; confirm exact service mode before travel.
